en: Black-and-white postcard view of a rural inn or guesthouse surrounded by trees and low forested hills. The main building has a steep gabled roof and timbered upper facade with the large inscription "Gasthof Bärenfels" on the side. In the foreground there is a fenced garden area and a small path; behind the house rises a wooded slope. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the image.
